content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: LWC Experience Cloud (Beta) ## slug: vt-lwc-experience-cloud ## seoTitle: LWC Experience Cloud (Beta) ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Use the new {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} on any Lightning {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} page, including those with Guest User (unauthenticated) access. ![Virtual Terminal - LWC Experience Cloud](https://youtu.be/MQeEtxvwcjc){height="480" width="640"} :::(Warning) (IMPORTANT TO KNOW) * The LWC Experience Cloud (Beta) does not enforce sharing rules. * A guest must be assigned the site guest user permission set. * Additional configuration for Account READ/WRITE and Contact READ/WRITE need to be assigned for relationship settings to work. * The related to lookup field is not visible when enabled for a guest user. ::: **Experience Builder Component** The {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} is in the Visualforce component in the Experience Builder. ![LWCExperienceCloud_CommunityBuilder Component](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/LWCExperienceCloud_CommunityBuilder%20Component.png){height="" width=""} If the user cannot see the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} in the {{variable.Component_ExperienceCloudBuild}} or receives an error, please refer to our FAQ guide [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq#virtual-terminal){target=`_blank`}.
